en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a sloping market street in a small European town, looking toward a large Gothic-style church with a tall spire in the background. Multi‑story buildings line both sides of the street; signs on them advertise an apothecary and a business named Carl Sprotte. People are walking and working on the street, with a horse-drawn cart visible. Printed caption text at the top identifies the scene, and a vertical imprint on the right margin credits a printer and the year 1905.
